summary.name: Paper Cutout Illustration, under Printmaking and Craft Materials, with explicit provenance in the source.
summary.visualIdentity: Objects are built from clearly cut paper shapes with thin visible edges and soft contact shadows. Paper colors and material types are limited. Pieces move on believable joints through sliding, rotation, and folding, avoiding intersections and conflicting shadow directions.
summary.suitableUses: The source names no specific use cases. Inferred fit: jointed paper pieces and contact shadows can carry a story alone, suiting calm, tactile explainers or craft-themed narratives. Hybrid approaches are warranted only for a formal depth camera or quantified information.
summary.limitations: A procedural paper curl is an artistic bend, not a physical paper solver. Flat SVG or Canvas cutouts suit flat scenes, and 3D is needed only for depth or curling. Vector rendering adds no physical paper texture. Two-color contrast checks do not verify readability over textures or video.
summary.palette: Suggested tokens are background #F2EAD8 (cream), foreground #304849 (dark teal ink), accent_1 #C17F63 (terracotta), and accent_2 #829776 (sage), with no gradient. These are authored suggestions; task, brand, or approved colors override them and must not be altered. Foreground on background measures 8.161:1 and meets normal text. Accent pairings measure about 3.0:1 and are decorative only.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Motion uses one paused, seekable timeline with a single owner per animated property, plus deliberate pose changes at pivots and joints. Stepped exposure, sharp cuts, and reading holds are preserved; easing is not required everywhere. Reviewed references motion-037 and motion-038 apply only when matching letters or punctuation exist. Motion-006, 009, 012, and 015 are conditional candidates. Live pointer or scroll behavior is excluded from video export.
summary.audio: The source specifies no audio direction for this style. Music, voiceover, sound effects, ambience, or silence are all options to suggest per task. Inferred: restrained, tactile sound accents could match slides and joint movements, but this is not source-defined. Honor any supplied audio requirements first, avoid competing with narration, and never add audio assets without authorization.
summary.assetRequirements: Layered artwork needs transparent PNG or vector contours with consistent dimensions and clear naming, plus a layer manifest. Pivots and parent-child joint connections must be defined. Contact-shadow pieces and fonts must be preloaded. No assets were supplied in the metadata, so missing assets must be reported. Motion-037 and motion-038 require actual phrase or punctuation assets.
summary.combinations: style-101 can add restrained depth parallax to paper planes, with one shared camera and whole-plane offsets. style-097 can render paper-cut data strips for at most three categories, using only accent_1, accent_2, and foreground, with text on the cream background. The source avoids paper curl on data marks. These cross-references are not verified here.
summary.productionApproach: HyperFrames is the default render pipeline for composition, timing, validation, and export, with Remotion as a documented fallback only. SVG is the recommended primary renderer; PixiJS and Paper.js are optional. GSAP is the motion engine, with Motion and procedural curl optional. chroma-js validates colors. Verify decoded frames, direct and backward seeks, and audio sync.
